signals.signal: SICAP's undocumented public JSON API is reachable and filterable without login: POST https://e-licitatie.ro/api-pub/NoticeCommon/GetCNoticeList/ with {"contractName":"<kw>","sysNoticeTypeIds":[],"sortProperties":[]} filters contract notices, and POST https://e-licitatie.ro/api-pub/DirectAcquisitionCommon/GetDirectAcquisitionList/ with {"directAcquisitionName":"<kw>"} returns direct-award records INCLUDING the named winning supplier, its fiscal code, the contracting authority and the closing value. Endpoint names were recovered from the Angular bundle https://e-licitatie.ro/app-pub. The award-notice endpoint GetCANoticeList ignores its contractObject filter (returns the unfiltered 3,000-row cap).
signals.source_name: SICAP / e-licitatie.ro public API (api-pub), verified live
signals.implies: Gives Printec a repeatable, no-login monitoring route into the whole Romanian public-sector demand pool for cash-handling, POS acquiring and self-service kiosks, including named competitor wins at direct-award level.
signals.followup: Add the two working endpoints to the source access registry; schedule a weekly keyword sweep.

signals.signal: CEC Bank's own procurement page cec.ro/achizitii, which returned 403 to the fetch tool in prior runs, is reachable when requested with a desktop browser User-Agent (HTTP 200, 97,630 bytes). As of 01/08/2026 it lists only TWO procedures, both already closed: (a) risk analyses for physical security of CEC Bank premises, offer deadline 23/04/2026; (b) an IT messaging (Info SMS) solution, offer deadline 13/03/2026. NO ATM, self-service, cash-recycling or POS procedure is currently published there.
signals.implies: The baseline watch item 'CEC Romania post-rollout maintenance/managed services' is NOT yet on the market. CEC buys as a commercial bank outside public-procurement law, so Printec must work the account directly rather than wait for a portal notice.
signals.likelihood: No live CEC hardware/self-service tender in the next 1-2 months on current evidence
signals.followup: Poll cec.ro/achizitii weekly with a desktop UA; approach CEC procurement directly on ATM/recycler maintenance.
